The best model I scored was −a·t^b·(1−e^(−cP)) − d·P − e·P² − f·t·P − g·t^h·P·e^(−iP) − j·√t·e^(−P), with a training NMSE of 5.35e-5. A full linear basis of t- and P-terms reached about 8e-7, so the right terms are likely in that family, but I did not identify the exact closed form.
